what: A small packet runs a relay along the card line — it appears at the first card after half a beat, hops to the next card every 1.5 beats and vanishes at the end. A card the packet touches glows at two-beat intervals and settles over 1.5 beats, the status text inside the card slides out by −6px while the next text rises in from 6px below. Eight beats per loop, paused when off screen

options.bpm: Beat tempo — all lengths in beat units, default 142 (one beat .4225s)
